messages:
andrew: Noticed a repeating pattern in staging: short leases + softcap revokes -> burst of reclaims -> latency spikes. filing a follow-up to the lease RFC.

lina: can you give a quick one-line timeline and impact numbers?

andrew: timeline: borrow_rate rises -> controller revokes leases -> tenants reissue -> borrow_rate rises again. period ~4m. p95 latency up ~30% during cycles.

sam: I reproduced this in the stress harness when lease_ttl <= 45s. amplitude grows with more tenants.

maria: sounds like a classic feedback loop. propose "lease_smoothing_guard" primitive in admission API to limit reclaim velocity and add hysteresis.

kevin: agree. runtime eviction policy matters too. immediate KV evict amplifies load. suggest delayed async eviction and local backoff.

lina: ownership idea: admission publishes a small smoothing token (min_reclaim_ms, hysteresis_pct, emergency_bypass). runtime may enforce stronger local limits. keep control plane simple.

maria: sample token: "min_reclaim_ms=120000,hysteresis=0.15,max_burst=2,bypass_score=0.8". also add an "oscillation_flag" metric if autocorr(borrow_rate,lag=1..5) > thresh.

sam: tradeoff: longer min_reclaim increases fairness lag and could be abused. we need an abuse fast-path that bypasses smoothing when abuse_score high.

kevin: telemetry-bot: added metric panels: borrow_rate, reclaim_rate, lease_churn, autocorr_flag. will emit alerts if oscillation_flag = true for 2 windows.

andrew: rollout plan: (1) API schema PR (maria) (2) runtime opt-in + metrics (kevin) (3) telemetry detector (sam) (4) canary 10% tenants (lina). success: reduce autocorr by >50% and keep median latency within 5%.

lina: I'll add dashboards and alert thresholds. sync tomorrow after maria PR. :+1:
